title: React 18 is supported in Next.js 15 Pages Router
condition: The application uses the Pages Router. This exception does not establish React 18 compatibility for the App Router.
effect: Next.js 15 (including the 15.1 announcement) retains Pages Router support for React 18.
sourceEvidence: Next.js 15 release announcement explicitly says Pages Router is backward compatible with React 18 and warns against mixed router React versions. Next.js 15.1 says Pages Router continues to support React 18.
